insights.one_liner: Large Dutch bank headquartered in Amsterdam; IND sponsor with English-language jobs and internships that mostly show pay.

culture.text: About 22,500 people work at the bank, more than 5,000 of them outside the Netherlands.
Staff mostly studied economics, business, finance and law at UvA, VU, Amsterdam UAS, Erasmus and Utrecht.
Its 10 jobs are in Amsterdam and Amstelveen, including 5 internships, mainly finance and risk and compliance.

open.text: ABN AMRO Bank N.V. and ABN AMRO Asset Based Finance N.V. are IND recognised sponsors.
None of its 10 jobs here require Dutch, and 70% show pay.

growth.text: Staff grew from 18,830 in 2018 to 20,872 in 2023.
Revenue was €8.716 billion in 2025, with a net profit of €2.252 billion.
Extended its partnership with Infosys to simplify IT and speed up its AI rollout.

worth_knowing.text: ABN AMRO and unions are clashing over mandatory office days and wages in collective agreement talks.
Gerrit Zalm will definitively not be prosecuted in the ABN AMRO money laundering case.
The Kingdom of the Netherlands is listed among its owners.
